meta.title: 2-Channel ÷11 Voltage Divider → ESP32 ADC (demo)
meta.intro: DEMO: a 2-channel ÷11 resistor voltage divider feeding an ESP32's ADC, built on two snapped ElectroCookie strip boards (34×19). Rails are the outer column of each board (cols 1/17/18/34); the field is horizontal 3-hole runs. An ESP32 DevKit V1 (30-pin) sits centered, left header at col 13. Shows board mode with resistor, diode, and node-tie net kinds.

notes.html: Header layout. Left header (col 13), pins top→bottom: EN(3), VP(4), VN(5), GPIO34(6), GPIO35(7), …, GND(16), VIN(17) — USB at the top (EN) end. The ADC-capable pins sit near the top, right by the channels.

buildOrder: Sockets + terminal first. Female headers for the DevKit (cols 13 & 22, USB at the top/EN edge — VIN lands at row 17, GND at row 16) and the 3-pin screw terminal (row 3, GND pin on the col-1 rail).
Grounds first: JEG (ESP GND → col-1 rail), JG1, JG2. Verify terminal-GND ↔ ESP-GND ↔ col-1 rail = 0 Ω.
CH1: R1a (10k), tie NT1, R1b (1k), D1 (band toward NODE1), tie GT1, then S1 (NODE1 → GPIO34).
CH2: feed JF2, R2a (10k), tie NT2, R2b (1k), D2, tie GT2, S2 (NODE2 → GPIO35).
Pre-power check (below), then plug in the ESP via USB.
checks: Continuity, power off: terminal GND ↔ ESP GND ↔ col-1 rail = 0 Ω. CH1+ ↔ NODE1 ≈ 10 kΩ; NODE1 ↔ GND ≈ 1 kΩ. Same for CH2.
Divider, 12 V into CH1+/GND: NODE1 ≈ 1.09 V (12 ÷ 11). ~12 V → bottom 1 kΩ open; ~0 V → top 10 kΩ open.
Reverse clamp: briefly reverse CH1 leads — NODE1 clamps to ≈ −0.3 V. If it swings hard negative, the 1N5819 band is backwards.
Then plug in the ESP over USB and read the two ADC channels (GPIO34/GPIO35); calibrate the divider ratio against a known-good meter.
